summary: Ran public API regression tests and mobile UI integration checks. Registration/contact persistence, four PDF downloads, responsive layout, navigation, and detail hash URLs passed. Share action currently triggers a React runtime overlay when clipboard permission is denied.

critical.issue: Resend notification attempt fails for labkomlangitan25@gmail.com because the configured Resend testing account only permits delivery to the provider-owned address; registration remains stored and API returns 200.

ui_bugs.issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText rejection is uncaught. Browser displays the webpack runtime error overlay and blocks the close button when clipboard permission is denied.

action_items: Catch clipboard write failures and still show share feedback or fallback copy behavior without a runtime overlay.
Verify Resend domain/sender and recipient configuration so notifications reach labkomlangitan25@gmail.com; current delivery is rejected by Resend.
critical_code_review_comments: Share button performs an async clipboard operation without awaiting or catching its rejected promise.
Registration email failure is intentionally swallowed after logging, so the 200 response does not indicate notification failure; provide operational monitoring or an explicit status strategy.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST-prefixed registration and contact records in the configured test database through public APIs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: API tests and mobile download/detail flows were executed. Re-test share permission-denied behavior, then complete registration/contact UI assertions after fixing the runtime overlay. PDF downloads and responsive overflow passed.
rca of the issue: Share handler calls navigator.clipboard?.writeText(window.location.href) without a catch. In the public browser context clipboard permission is denied, producing an unhandled NotAllowedError; CRA's dev overlay iframe then intercepts all pointer events, including close. Resend rejects the notification because onboarding@resend.dev/testing mode cannot send to the requested Gmail recipient without domain verification.
